objects.description: red split rocker switch labeled BAT / ALT at the lower left of the instrument panel; up = ON
round fuel selector at the bottom right of the panel with positions OFF and BOTH and a white pointer
red ribbed plunger knob labeled MIXTURE at the bottom center of the panel; pushed in = RICH, pulled out = IDLE CUTOFF
key switch at the left of the panel with positions OFF, R, L, BOTH, START
the piston engine; its state shows on the tachometer (RPM) and the propeller in the windshield
round RPM gauge right of the six main instruments, 0 to 3500 RPM
white flap lever in a slotted gate at the right of the panel, detents 0, 10, 20 and 30 degrees
rocker switch labeled LAND in the row of light switches at the bottom left of the panel; up = ON
T-handle labeled PARK BRAKE at the bottom left of the panel; pulled out = SET, pushed in = released
black round plunger knob labeled THROTTLE at the bottom center of the panel; pushed in = full power, pulled out = idle
the control yoke; pulling it raises the nose, seen as the windshield horizon dropping and the attitude indicator pitching up
airspeed indicator, the top left of the six main instruments, in knots
attitude indicator, top center of the six main instruments, blue sky over brown ground
altimeter, top right of the six main instruments, in feet
vertical speed indicator, bottom right of the six main instruments, hundreds of feet per minute
the asphalt runway with white centerline seen through the windshield

actions.visual_cue: at the left of the panel the two red MASTER rocker switches (BAT, ALT) flip up and the small pills above them change from dark 'OFF' to green 'ON'; the amber LOW VOLTS and red OIL PRESS annunciators in the top row light up
at the bottom right the round FUEL SELECTOR changes from its lower half lit red ('OFF') to its upper half lit green ('BOTH'); the white pointer turns from down to up

at the bottom center the red ribbed MIXTURE knob goes from pulled out (low and big on a long chrome shaft, red 'CUTOFF' placard above it) to pushed in flush, and the placard above it turns green 'RICH'

the ignition key at the left turns to START: an amber 'START' pill lights beside the key and the amber STARTER annunciator in the top row lights; the black propeller blades in the windshield start turning and blur into a gray disc while the tachometer needle rises
at the bottom right the white flap lever moves down to the 10° mark and the FLAPS readout above it changes from a white '0°' to a green '10°'
the white flap lever moves all the way down to the bottom 30° mark and the FLAPS readout above it shows a red '30°'
in the row of five black rocker switches at the bottom left (BCN, LAND, TAXI, NAV, STROBE) the second one, LAND, flips up and the pill above it changes from dark 'OFF' to green 'ON'
at the bottom left the PARK BRAKE handle is pushed in flush, the red 'SET' flag under it disappears and the red PARK BRAKE annunciator in the top row goes dark

at the bottom center the black THROTTLE knob (white rim) goes from pulled out low on a chrome shaft to pushed in flush, the placard above it turns green 'FULL' and the tachometer needle swings right to about 23

the nose rises: in the windshield the horizon and the runway drop toward the bottom of the view and sky fills it, the runway falling away below the cowling; on the panel the attitude indicator's brown ground drops below its center line

the nose rises (the horizon drops in the windshield and the attitude indicator pitches up) while the red STALL annunciator at the right end of the top row lights up and the runway is still right below
airborne and climbing: the windshield shows mostly sky with the horizon low and no runway close below; the altimeter needles keep turning and the vertical speed needle points up and right
